name: @koru/autopilot-shared
description: Shared stable utilities (NDJSON protocol envelopes, socket path resolution, host-OS keyboard/click injection) used by every per-IDE koru autopilot VSIX. Code lands in each plugin's src/_shared/ via scripts/sync-plugin-shared.py at prebuild time so each plugin's VSIX remains fully self-contained and a regression in one plugin cannot leak into another by sharing a runtime module.
